title: Earplugs
description: The Earplugs mod allows you to change the volume with just a click of a button.
body:
Earplugs is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that allows you to change game volume using custom keybinds. It provides on-the-fly audio control without the need to open the settings menu. You can easily adjust master volume with keybinds, lower or increase sound levels instantly. It is the perfect solution for anyone looking to change game volume with hotkeys.

![Volume adjustment showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gXKEFjVC/images/2fefa7e1b30585fe249c8d0597e1725881d17c83.png)
